description: This file implements an authentication context provider for a React application. It manages user session state, persists sessions to local storage, handles login, registration, and logout actions, and listens for storage events to synchronize authentication state across multiple tabs.

methods.name: readStoredSession
methods.description: Reads the authentication session from local storage, parsing the JSON stored under a specific key.

methods.name: writeStoredSession
methods.description: Persists the authentication session to local storage or removes it if null.
